get.description: Matches email or name; synthetic demo students are left out. At most 200, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get

post.description: The account can no longer sign in and its sessions end. Its data is kept; enabling it restores access.
A one-time password for the admin to pass on in person; every existing session of that user ends.

patch.description: Takes effect at once: roles are read from the database on every request, not from the token.

post.description: Self-registration always creates a student; staff accounts come from app.manage.

get.description: Due dates between `start` and `end` (at most 100 days) for the courses the caller is in or teaches.

schema.title: Response Calendar Api V1 Calendar Get

get.description: The current notice, with the model providers that are actually configured.

post.description: From now on nothing of this student's is processed until they agree again.

get.description: Archived courses are listed only for their own teacher, who can restore them.

schema.title: Response List Courses Api V1 Courses Get

get.description: F-64: completion, score distribution and where each assignment stands, for one course.
Newest first.

schema.title: Response List Announcements Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Announcements Get

post.description: Hidden from the course list and closed to new students; everything in it is kept and can be restored.

get.description: Every assignment in the course by due date; a student also gets their own score for each.

schema.title: Response List Assignments Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Assignments Get

delete.description: Removes the assignment only; the students' submissions stay.

put.description: Changing the problems or the due date changes every score at once: scores are computed, not stored.

post.description: Returns every graded piece of work that has not been returned yet.

get.description: The concepts problems and notes can be tagged with (F-02).

schema.title: Response List Concepts Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Concepts Get

post.description:
Add a concept to the course's list (F-02). Mastery starts at the population prior and uses the default
slip and guess rates until an instructor tunes them, so nothing else has to be set up.

delete.description: Only an unused concept can be deleted; one in use can be renamed instead.

patch.description: Renaming keeps every tag and the whole mastery history, which follow the concept, not its name.

get.description: A student gets the published modules and items with their own completions; staff get everything.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Documents Get

delete.description: Removes the notes and their search chunks; a stored explanation that cited them is checked again before use.
The student leaves; their work and mastery history stay (deleting data is the erasure request).

get.description: The course's failure-signature cache, most used first, for review (F-62).

schema.title: Response Stored Explanations Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Explanations Get

get.description: One row per student and assignment: the on-time score, the score with late work, and the status (F-04).
The current mastery value of every student for every concept in the course.
The mastery ledger: every change with its before and after value, the rule and the evidence behind it.
Students by assignment: the on-time score, what late work would make it, and a status for each.

post.description: Send every LMS student's on-time score for each assignment to the LMS the course was opened from.

patch.description: Text and link items change in place; a file is replaced by deleting it and adding another.

get.description: The PDF as an attachment, so the browser saves it instead of rendering it inside this site.

schema.title: Response Misconceptions Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Misconceptions Get

delete.description: Removes the module, its items and every student's completions of them.

schema.title: Response List Quizzes Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Quizzes Get

get.description: Staff get the right answers; a student gets the questions only.
The student's own attempts; the right answers only when review is open (see the module note).

put.description: One rating per enrolled student; saving again replaces it.

delete.description: The teacher removes a student from the course; their work and history stay.

get.description: Mastery, suspected misconceptions and submissions in this course, newest first (at most 100).
The same ledger the student sees: each change with the test, error and rule behind it (F-34).

schema.title: Response Student History Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Students  Student Id  Mastery  Concept Id  History Get

get.description: The code as submitted and its result. Opening it is audited: a student's code is their personal data.

post.description: Approve a stored explanation, approve an edited claim, or reject it (F-62).

get.description: F-64: totals over the instructor's own live courses and their next assignments.

F-76: every assignment with handed-in work across the instructor's own live courses, with how many pieces wait
for a score, how many are scored and how many of those are not yet returned.

schema.title: Response To Review Api V1 Instructor To Review Get

get.description: The tool's public key set. The LMS checks the tool's grade-service token requests against it.

post.description: The signed launch from the platform: checked, then mapped to an account and a course.

get.description: OIDC login initiation from the platform, sent as a redirect.

post.description: OIDC login initiation from the platform, sent as a form post.
Swap a launch's one-time code (valid for a minute, usable once) for a session token.

patch.description: The name teachers see in the class view and gradebook. It is never sent to the AI model (TR-S-06).

post.description: Schedules deletion of the whole account, its submissions, chat and mastery, 48 hours from now.
Signs out every other session; the reply carries a fresh token so this one carries on.

get.description: Students see live problems only; staff also see archived ones, marked as such.

post.description:
A model-written practice problem for one concept, offered only after both of its solutions were checked in the
sandbox (TR-L-10). The instructor reviews it and saves it with POST /problems; nothing is stored here.

put.description:
Checked in the sandbox exactly like a new problem, then marked for review again. Past submissions keep the
results they had.

post.description: Hidden from students and never chosen again; submissions, history and existing assignments keep it.

put.description:
How many hints a student may take, and how strictly replies are kept from resembling the solution (F-62).
The leak guard can only be made stricter than the tuned default, never looser.

post.description: The instructor has read the problem and its tests; this clears the 'needs human review' flag.

get.description: The full problem for its editor, hidden tests and reference solution included.
F-63: the student's own score for every assignment of every course they are enrolled in.

schema.title: Response My Grades Api V1 Students Me Grades Get

get.description: Every change to one concept, with the test, error and rule behind it (F-34).

schema.title: Response History Api V1 Students Me Mastery  Concept Id  History Get

get.description: F-63: enrolled courses, average score, progress per course and the next assignments still to finish.
Every assignment of the student's live courses, soonest first, each marked assigned, missing or done.

schema.title: Response My Todo Api V1 Students Me Todo Get

post.description: Run against the visible examples only; nothing is stored.
F-14: run the code once on the caller's own input. Nothing is stored or graded, and no test case is involved.
Runs generation and verification to completion before answering, so no unchecked text is ever shown.
